description: This file contains unit tests for the 'calculate' function in a calculator application, using the Chai assertion library and Mocha testing framework. It tests various calculator button sequences and their expected outputs.

methods.name: pressButtons
methods.description: Simulates pressing a sequence of calculator buttons and returns the resulting calculator state.

methods.name: expectButtons
methods.description: Asserts that pressing a sequence of buttons results in an expected calculator state.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case for a sequence of buttons and expected output, optionally only running this test.
